summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing the commencement of drilling at its newly defined Orion target and plans to drill the Victory target in Q4-2026 at the Guayabales Project in Colombia. The press release details exploration results, including surface sampling up to 7.43 g/t gold and 230 g/t silver, and highlights the targets' proximity to the Apollo system and Aris Mining's Marmato mine. This is a routine operational update on exploration activities, not a special-situation corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, transaction structure, or board recommendation are provided, and the filing presents no strategic alternatives or capital markets action.
